title: Changelog - May 2016
text:
## Changelog - May 2016
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093652
New Features:
Basic Leads Package available for all Bootstrap Theme websites.
Auto-matching Package available for a yearly fee to all Bootstrap Theme websites.
Advanced Leads Settings Package available for a yearly fee to all Bootstrap Theme websites.
Froala Editor for Admin Content Pages Module.
Custom Styled Google Maps .
New Password Module (Security Enhancement).
Latest Version for Font-Awesome ( New Icons are available ).
Latest Version for Froala Editor.
New Profile/Logo Photo Upload Module. (Alpha Version).
New Articles Website Search.
Ability to Hide/Show the Google Map, Top, Sub, Sub-Sub level categories in Leads Forms.
Alpha Support for Finansbank Payment in Turkey.
Enhancements / Fixes:
Full Optimizations to the code Infrastructure with enhancements in all modules of the system.
More than 40+ bugs fixed ranging from Backend, Admin Panel, Frontend and more.
